secondary_contrasts: Aab+ contrasts; no assumption that Aab+ is a clinical disease stage
multiplicity: BH across ten slots; unavailable tests retain a slot and no fabricated p-value
covariates: log section area unless area is the exposure
spatial_primary: non-overlapping, geometrically valid, assessable tissue-clipped regions; 20 um band

hypotheses.donor_selection: ND and T1D primary; Aab+ secondary

hypotheses.donor_selection: ND and T1D primary; Aab+ secondary

hypotheses.title: Added microenvironment information
hypotheses.test: Nested donor-held-out balanced accuracy improvement of full regularized profile over demographics, size and endocrine composition; permute donor labels through the whole procedure
hypotheses.markers: all 31 plus structural densities and spatial summaries
hypotheses.donor_selection: ND and T1D primary; Aab+ secondary
hypotheses.permutation: All balanced binary donor-label allocations, complete nested fitting; 3432 for 7 ND + 7 T1D

followups.rule: If H1 and H2/H3 have q<0.05, test size by implicated structural density; choose smaller q, capillary on tie. Otherwise test H1 adjusted for both densities.
If H4 has q<0.05, omnibus lymphatic-neighborhood enrichment of CD8, CD4, B and macrophage-associated subsets; otherwise peri versus distant lymphatic localization.

If H7 and H8 have q<0.05, test duct distance by ColIV coverage; if only one, its disease interaction; if neither, report unsupported mechanism and uncertainty. Missing tests cannot establish non-support.

If H9/H10 yield stable features, test an INS-independent signature against held-out insulin-positive tissue burden, then secondary C-peptide association; otherwise prespecified size plus structural density signature.

followup_family: exploratory same-cohort; independent replication requires new donors
pseudotime_family: separate BH family; full-cohort descriptive curves are not inferential tests
endocrine_denominator: All canonical cell centroids inside the endocrine pixel-classifier core, counted once; downstream typing cannot revoke classifier eligibility

feature_stability.comparison_features: standardized H9 marker-dispersion disease coefficients or nested H10 classifier coefficients

F4_stable_signature.typing_reconstructed: each outer and inner donor-held-out fold
F4_stable_signature.conditional_labels: aligned only to reviewed training-donor identities; no production changes
F4_stable_signature.profile: mean log1p within conditionally typed expanded endocrine cells; minimum five per islet
F4_stable_signature.candidate_features: remaining 30 markers plus log area and validated core nerve/core capillary/peri lymphatic densities
F4_stable_signature.selection: top eight absolute training-donor Spearman associations with tissue burden, repeated inside inner and outer folds
F4_stable_signature.endpoint: validated INS-positive tissue area / valid core area; never substitute cell composition

supporting_trajectory.typing_omission: complete outcome marker module and relevant phenotype dependencies
supporting_trajectory.preprocessing: four cell-typing fits reconstructed in each donor-held-out fold; outcome-independent training reference alignment
supporting_trajectory.effect: donor-mean held-out MSE improvement from a cubic trajectory smooth over demographic/size baseline
supporting_trajectory.endocrine_outcomes: descriptive only because complete endocrine-module omission removes denominator evidence
supporting_trajectory.family: separate BH family; no primary hypothesis reuse
